responsibility: Implements the analyzer-specific diagnostic_event subclasses that populate emitted path diagnostics. This file turns exploded-graph transitions and analysis actions into labeled path events, handles inlining-aware logical locations and stack-depth correction, supports event preparation for final emission IDs, and provides specialized wording for calls, returns, state changes, setjmp/longjmp rewinds, inlined calls, and final warning sites.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementations of the checker_event hierarchy declared in checker-event.h, including event text/meaning generation, inlining-aware depth correction, emission-time hooks, and specialized behavior for setjmp/longjmp and warning events.
